recognize_zh: 油鏡下可見一顆紅血球內有深紫色圓點（Howell-Jolly body）、一顆偏大偏藍的多染性紅血球（polychromatophil），並有邊緣缺角或凹陷的紅血球（bite cell），配合藥物史指向氧化性溶血。
features: Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with numerous crenated cells (echinocytes), likely partly artifactual
Single dense round purple inclusion within a red cell consistent with a Howell-Jolly body
Occasional larger, bluish-grey polychromatophilic red cells
A few red cells with irregular peripheral defects or eccentric clearing suggestive of bite/blister cells
Fine punctate inclusions in some red cells; convincing coarse basophilic stippling is not clearly resolved
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Leishman stain, high power) shows red cells with anisopoikilocytosis and many crenated forms, which may partly reflect drying artifact. A red cell containing a single dense round inclusion consistent with a Howell-Jolly body is present, along with polychromatophilic cells and occasional cells with peripheral bites or eccentric clearing. Fine punctate inclusions are seen in a few cells, but definite basophilic stippling is not clearly resolved at this resolution. In the appropriate drug history, findings are suggestive of oxidative (drug-induced) hemolysis.

ddx.vs: Morphology (bite and blister cells, Heinz bodies) is identical, so a G6PD enzyme assay after recovery of reticulocytosis is needed to separate it from drug-induced hemolysis in a G6PD-normal patient.
Immune hemolysis is characterized by spherocytes and a positive direct antiglobulin test rather than bite and blister cells.
Howell-Jolly bodies with target cells and acanthocytes but without bite/blister cells or Heinz bodies favor hyposplenism rather than oxidative hemolysis.
Artifactual echinocytes have evenly spaced short projections across many cells in thick areas and lack true peripheral bites or hemoglobin-free blisters.
